name: evaldossier
description: Offline verification and fixed synthetic conformance for portable signed EvalDossier dossiers.

interface.longDescription: Verify portable signed evaluation dossiers against caller-supplied expected audience and nonce pins, or exercise the fixed synthetic reference evaluator. The plugin performs no settlement or network requests.
defaultPrompt: Use $evaldossier:verify to verify this dossier offline using the audience and nonce I provide.
